Package Model

Class Business

java.lang.Object
Model.Entity
Model.User
Model.Business
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class Business extends User implements android.os.Parcelable
Represents a business account, which extends a User. Holds business-specific data: courses offered, location, followers, ratings, policy, and address. Implements Parcelable so Business instances can be passed between Android components.
